caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure on a rectangular pedestal. The figure is dressed in brown pants and boots, a tan jacket, a red sash across his chest, a grey fur piece around the waist, and a light blue turban or headdress. His right hand is raised and holding a bunch of brown leaves. The pedestal is light grey and on the front and side faces, it is labeled with the words “A. SONNEMAN—TOBACCO” in black capital letters. The background is plain or off-white, making the colored statue the central focus of the composition.
title: Cigar Store Indian
